title: Starting Strength – Workout A
creator: Mark Rippetoe (Starting Strength)
description: Rippetoe's novice linear progression: squat, a press and a pull, three sets of five, three days a week on alternating A/B days, adding weight every single session. Phase 1 deadlifts every day; Phase 2 (modelled here) swaps in 5×3 power cleans on day B; Phase 3 alternates deadlift/clean on A and does chin-ups on B. Press and bench also alternate each session independently of the A/B day, so in practice you press one workout and bench the next.

source.title: The Starting Strength Novice Program
source.author: Mark Rippetoe (Starting Strength)
source.license: Freely published program; description in our own words

items.name: Squat 3×5
items.note: Source gives no rest time; 3 min used (3–5 min between heavy sets is the norm)

steps.note: Work sets only, after warm-up sets. +10 lb (5 kg) per session at first, then +5 lb (2.5 kg)

items.name: Press 3×5
items.note: Source gives no rest time; 3 min used (3–5 min between heavy sets is the norm)

steps.note: Alternates with bench press every session. +5 lb (2.5 kg), micro-load to 2.5 lb (1 kg) later

items.name: Deadlift 1×5
items.note: Source gives no rest time; 3 min used (3–5 min between heavy sets is the norm)

steps.note: One work set. +15–20 lb (7.5–10 kg) the first few sessions, then +10 lb (5 kg), then +5 lb (2.5 kg)
